title: 3dTstat
description: Compute voxel-wise statistics using AFNI 3dTstat command

abssum.description: Compute absolute sum of input voxels.
abssum.title: Absolute Sum

slope.description: Compute the slope of input voxels vs. time.
slope.title: Slope

stdev.description: Compute standard deviation of input voxels.
stdev.title: Standard Deviation

stdevNOD.description: Compute standard deviation of input voxels without detrending.
stdevNOD.title: Standard Deviation No Detrending

cvar.description: Compute coefficient of variation of input voxels.
cvar.title: Coefficient of Variation

cvarNOD.description: Compute coefficient of variation of input voxels without detrending.
cvarNOD.title: Coefficient of Variation No Detrending

cvarinv.description: Compute inverse coefficient of variation of input voxels.
cvarinv.title: Inverse Coefficient of Variation

cvarinvNOD.description: Compute inverse coefficient of variation of input voxels without detrending.
cvarinvNOD.title: Inverse Coefficient of Variation No Detrending

tsnr.description: Compute temporal signal to noise ratio.
tsnr.title: Temporal Signal to Noise Ratio

MAD.description: Compute median absolute deviation of input voxels.
MAD.title: Median Absolute Deviation

DW.description: Compute Durbin-Watson Statistic of input voxels.
DW.title: Durbin-Watson Statistic

nzmedian.description: Compute median of non-zero input voxels.
nzmedian.title: Non-Zero Median

nzstdev.description: Compute standard deviation of non-zero input voxels.
nzstdev.title: Non-Zero Standard Deviation

bmv.description: Compute biweight midvariance of input voxels.
bmv.title: Biweight Midvariance

MSSD.description: Compute mean of successive squared differences of input voxels.
MSSD.title: Mean of Successive Squared Differences

MSSDsqrt.description: Compute square root of mean of successive squared differences of input voxels.
MSSDsqrt.title: Square Root of MSSD

MASDx.description: Compute median of absolute values of first time differences of input voxels.
MASDx.title: Median of Absolute Values of First Time Differences

absmax.description: Compute absolute maximum of input voxels.
absmax.title: Absolute Maximum

signed_absmax.description: Compute signed absolute maximum of input voxels.
signed_absmax.title: Signed Absolute Maximum

percentile.description: Compute the P-th percentile point of the data in each voxel time series.
percentile.title: Percentile

argmin.description: Compute index of minimum of input voxels.
argmin.title: Index of Minimum

argmin1.description: Compute index + 1 of minimum of input voxels.
argmin1.title: Index + 1 of Minimum

argmax.description: Compute index of maximum of input voxels.
argmax.title: Index of Maximum

argmax1.description: Compute index + 1 of maximum of input voxels.
argmax1.title: Index + 1 of Maximum

argabsmax.description: Compute index of absolute maximum of input voxels.
argabsmax.title: Index of Absolute Maximum

argabsmax1.description: Compute index + 1 of absolute maximum of input voxels.
argabsmax1.title: Index + 1 of Absolute Maximum

duration.description: Compute number of points around max above a threshold.
duration.title: Duration

onset.description: Compute beginning of duration around max where value exceeds basepercent.
onset.title: Onset

offset.description: Compute end of duration around max where value exceeds basepercent.
offset.title: Offset

centroid.description: Compute centroid of data time curves.
centroid.title: Centroid

centduration.description: Compute duration using centroid's index as center.
centduration.title: Centroid Duration

zcount.description: Count number of zero values at each voxel.
zcount.title: Zero Count

nzcount.description: Count number of non-zero values at each voxel.
nzcount.title: Non-Zero Count

autocorr.description: Compute autocorrelation function and return first n coefficients.
autocorr.title: Autocorrelation

autoreg.description: Compute autoregression coefficients and return first n coefficients.
autoreg.title: Autoregression

centromean.description: Compute mean of middle 50% of voxel values.
centromean.title: Centromean

kurtosis.description: Measure of the 'tailedness' of the probability distribution.
kurtosis.title: Kurtosis

tdiff.description: Take the first difference of each time series before further processing.
tdiff.title: First Difference

prefix.description: Use string 'p' for the prefix of the output dataset [DEFAULT = 'stat'].
prefix.title: Prefix

datum.description: Use data type 'd' for the type of storage of the output, where 'd' is one of 'byte', 'short', or 'float' [DEFAULT=float].
datum.title: Datum

nscale.description: Do not scale output values when datum is byte or short. Scaling is done by default.
nscale.title: No Scale

basepercent.description: Percentage of maximum for duration calculation.
basepercent.title: Base Percent

mask_mset.description: Use the dataset 'mset' as a mask. Only voxels with nonzero values in 'mset' will be printed from 'dataset'.
mask_mset.title: Mask Mset

mrange.description: Further restrict the voxels from 'mset' so that only those mask values between 'a' and 'b' (inclusive) will be used.
mrange.title: Mask Range

cmask.description: Execute the options enclosed in single quotes as a 3dcalc-like program, and produce a mask from the resulting 3D brick.
cmask.title: Cmask
